jobs.description: Deine Mission Produkt und Design sind bei Bling eine Rolle.Du baust bei uns eigene Features, vom User-Problem bis zum Release. Du findest das Problem, entwickelst das Konzept, gestaltest die Lösung selbst in Figma und briefst sie übergabereif für die Entwicklung. Nach dem Launch schaust du dir an, wie dein Feature genutzt wird, und entscheidest, was als Nächstes passiert. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of Product und trägst vom ersten Monat an die Verantwortung für deine Features. Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst Ownership für eigene Features, von der User-Problem-Discovery über die Konzeption bis zum Launch Du gestaltest die Lösungen selbst in Figma: User Flows und Screens auf Basis unseres Design Systems Du übersetzt deine Konzepte und Designs in klare Tickets für unsere Entwickler und erarbeitest die technische Umsetzung gemeinsam mit ihnen Du verantwortest Releases und stehst für die Qualität der gebauten Funktionen ein Du erkennst Reibungspunkte in der User Journey und entwickelst Lösungen, die Conversion, Activation und Retention messbar verbessern Du analysierst nach dem Launch die Nutzung, initiierst Experimente und A/B-Tests und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab Dein Profil Du hast schon etwas gebaut und kannst es zeigen: ein Feature, ein Side Project, eine App. Ob aus ein bis zwei Jahren im Product Management oder Product Design oder aus starken Praktika, ist uns egal Du hast Freude daran, Produkte zu skalieren, und willst sehen, dass sich deine Arbeit in den Zahlen zeigt Du wartest nicht auf Aufgaben. jobs.title: AI Brand Design Lead
jobs.description: Location: Remote, on US working hours · Reports to: Chief Growth Officer Background Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics for brands like Walmart, Urban Outfitters, and 7-Eleven, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the last year we've built a brand we genuinely love : a visual identity with real thought and meaning behind it, a motion system rooted in physics, a voice people notice, a website, a presence at the biggest trade shows in commerce. We're already an AI-obsessed team. Now we want to see what happens when someone with real creative taste and flair pairs with the velocity we've built. The Role We believe brand is one of the most important things a company builds, and the person in this seat has real creative authority. You will shape how Nash looks, moves, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Your taste sets the bar. We are hiring an AI Brand Design Lead to take that brand and push it into territory that wasn't possible before AI. Not redesign it. Not maintain it. Push it: more expressive motion, tighter systems, higher craft, broader application, faster velocity, and new creative territory that only opens up when you treat AI as a core design tool. Your superpower is taste. Your medium is AI. Your job is to make the two compound: taste sharp enough that AI finally gives you the velocity to match your ambition. Just as importantly, you think about brand as a platform. You'd rather build a system that lets any marketer on this team, armed with Claude and the right prompts, produce something fantastic and on-brand than review every output yourself. You raise the ceiling for your own work. You raise the floor for everyone else's. If you see AI as a threat to good design, this isn't the role for you. But if you believe that one person with real taste and the right tools can build a brand system that rivals teams ten times the size, and that the real unlock is making everyone on the team capable of shipping work with your standards b

jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.description: ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. The Opportunity As Head of Design, you will shape how people understand, direct and work with autonomous robots in some of the world’s most demanding industrial environments. This is not a conventional software design leadership role. Our products combine mobile robotics, operator interfaces, autonomous behaviour, inspection workflows and complex 3D data to support the people who plan, perform and act on industrial inspections. There are still few established design patterns for bringing these elements together into one intuitive, trusted experience. You will help create them. Today, our design capability spans UX/UI, product design, industrial design and future concept development across several teams. You will bring these disciplines together, establish a coherent design direction across the full product ecosystem and remain hands-on in solving the hardest design challenges. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Advanced Technology and our customer-facing teams. You will also spend time with customers and users in the industrial environments where our robots operate, ensuring that the experiences we pioneer solve real problems for the people who rely on them. Your Impact Lead and develop a multidisciplinary design team, setting clear goals, raising the quality bar and creating the conditions for strong designers to do their best work. Build understanding of the value of design across the organisation and strengthen the partnership between Product, Design and Engineering. Define a unified design vision across the physical robot, digital products, spatial interfaces and the end-to-end customer experience.
